source.verificationNotes: IDs and translation IDs transcribed from retrieved English and Spanish API inventory snapshots. Snapshots may differ in freshness; they are not a simultaneous integration test. Spanish topic 30602 was not in the retrieved snapshot and direct retrieval could not be independently verified. Routing labels, aliases, classifications and example prompts are application-authored, not official titles or medical recommendations.

scope.storage: Static navigation metadata only; no official article HTML, clinical recommendations, or eligibility rules stored. All health content is retrieved live.

routingRules.rule: Check safety and scope before ordinary navigation. Urgent symptoms, imminent danger, or self-harm concerns require appropriate safety response; the registry is not a triage engine.
If the consumer requests personalized preventive services, use WF-004 / MCP-006. Validate only supported inputs and do not infer demographics or eligibility from topic mapping.

Use the semantic objective plus audience and requested artifact to rank topic candidates. Explicit questions for a clinician, conversation starters, and shopping lists differ from general educational content.
Choose one primary workflow per request; secondary and universal skills are allowed for discovery, but do not duplicate the same retrieval unnecessarily.

Use localized topic ID from the requested language. Do not assume language equivalence or translate authoritative content yourself. If inventory is stale or a mapping is unverified, use MCP-001 to reconcile first.
For an ambiguous match, offer concise relevant choices or ask one focused clarification. Do not select a clinical service based on keywords alone.
If no mapping is found, invoke MCP-003 using live inventory fallback; select only an ID observed in the authoritative inventory.
After a successful MCP-004 call, use returned related-topic metadata without repeating retrieval. Follow-up selection invokes MCP-004 for the selected topic.

If live retrieval fails, disclose the failure; do not present static routing metadata as official guidance. Display official source logo/link and article update date when presenting MyHealthfinder content.
Safety context tags are non-clinical workflow hints only; they never establish diagnosis, clinical eligibility, urgency thresholds or a treatment recommendation.
